hero.headline: Cleaners for your Los Angeles buildings, hired close to the job.
hero.subhead: We find and screen cleaners, floor techs and supervisors for cleaning companies across LA, so your night shifts stay covered and you stop driving across town to fill in.

intro: Running a cleaning company in Los Angeles means covering buildings spread across a huge area, mostly at night, with a crew that can leave for a job a few dollars more or a few miles closer. When someone quits, the building still has to be cleaned tonight.

HireGladd works as your hiring team. We find people, talk with them first in English or Spanish, and send you only the ones who are ready to work. You interview, you decide. You pay one flat monthly fee, not a cut of every hire.
pains: I hire someone in the Valley for a building in Long Beach, and two weeks later they're gone.
My night cleaners have day jobs too. One schedule change and I lose them.
Every time we win a new account, I'm hiring from zero and covering shifts myself.

challenges.heading: What makes hiring cleaners in LA hard

items.title: The drive is why people quit.
items.body: A long drive across LA is one of the fastest ways to lose a cleaner. We look for people who live near your buildings, so the commute isn't the reason they leave.

items.title: Night and split shifts.
items.body: Many good cleaners already have a day job. We ask about their schedule up front, so you only meet people who can keep yours.

items.title: Pay rules change from city to city.
items.body: The City of Los Angeles and several nearby cities set their own minimum wage, so pay can differ from one building to the next. You set the pay, and we tell candidates up front.

items.title: English and Spanish.
items.body: Many of the best cleaners in LA speak Spanish first. We screen and talk with candidates in either language.

faqs.q: Do you hire for night shifts in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of the cleaning roles we fill in LA are evenings, overnights and weekends. We ask about schedules before you ever meet a candidate.

faqs.q: Can you find cleaners who live near a specific building?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us where your buildings are, and we focus on people within a reasonable drive of them.

faqs.q: Our buildings are in different LA cities with different pay. Can you handle that?
faqs.a: Yes. You set the pay for each building, and we tell candidates the pay up front, so there are no surprises in the interview.
Yes. We talk with candidates in English and Spanish.

faqs.q: What if a new hire quits in the first month?
faqs.a: If they leave in their first 30 days, we find a replacement at no extra cost.
One flat monthly fee, based on how many people you need. We'll give you the price on a short call. No per-hire fees.
